evidence: Refitted on 844 player-seasons, 2022-2026, CV folds cut by player. Constant CV MSE 7.4407 vs linear 7.5067 vs quadratic 7.5235 -- the constant still wins. Per-season usage/EPA correlation is negative in four of five seasons (-0.057,-0.021,-0.036,-0.027) and +0.072 only in 2026, so 2026's weak positive was noise.

Consequence of the above: the fitted expectation is a constant, so this is a constant offset of offensive_EPA_points_raw in every season, not just 2026. Redundancy class upgraded from a 2026 observation to a settled property.

Feasibility measured rather than assumed. Schedule connectivity is 1.00 in every season (all 28 pairings occur), so identifiability was never the blocker. But strength-of-schedule spread is only 15-29% of between-team spread, the ridge fit moves ranks by at most 2 places (Spearman 0.93-1.00), and in 2026 the adjustment is smaller than its own bootstrap SE (signal-to-noise 0.73). Implementing it would publish a number less reliable than the unadjusted one.
